name: Trawlerman Mick

intro.text: Three weeks off Bear Island, ice on the rigging, fish to the knees. You think you're tough? Go on then.

win: You'd have made a deckie. Not a skipper, mind.
after: Never whistle on a trawler. Never say 'pig' either. Call it a curly-tail. Old trawlermen'd turn the boat round for less.
